adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set and `userId` is truthy, the function returns the raw `fetch(...)` Response object without parsing JSON. In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is typed/used as `HubspotToken` but is now assigned from `await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`, so in sync mode it will be a `Response`, not a token payload. Any subsequent use like `hubspotRefreshToken.expiresIn * 1000` (or similar) and persisting `hubspotRefreshToken` into `credential.key` would be incorrect and can lead to NaN expiry and/or wiping/invalid credential data. The additional claim about the catch logging and allowing success isn't shown in this diff, but the Response-vs-token mismatch is directly verifiable here.
